dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no visible localized bulges or indentations along the body-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity consistent with a light-grey to off-white skin tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the lighter central dorsal region and slightly darker lateral margins.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct high-contrast dark circular point visible at the anterior region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Significant dark linear shadow-casting feature located along the central dorsal axis in the posterior section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical dark linear mark or ridge is visible on the posterior dorsal surface.
